create_crystal_from_array_dict: create a Crystal object from a dictionary containing frac_coords, atom_types, lengths, and angles arrays
parse_cif_to_crystal: parse a CIF string into a Crystal object with computed structure, composition, and validity
load_ground_truth_crystals: load ground truth crystal structures from a CSV or PT file using parallel CIF parsing
